brand.purpose: Space Grotesk 700 lockup for the Nintek wordmark.

display.purpose: Space Grotesk 800 house hero H1 with copper-gradient emphasis span.

body.purpose: Native system stack for house prose at line-height 1.6.

subworld-display.purpose: Archivo 800, near-1.0 line-height, for subworld hero H1 and headings.

data.purpose: Martian Mono uppercase micro-labels, proof strips, and state chips inside subworlds.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: House hero device mock — highest lift.

shadows.name: sortie-action-glow
shadows.purpose: Cobalt lift under Sortie's primary button; deepens on hover.

shadows.name: salvo-action-glow
shadows.purpose: Amber lift under Salvo's primary button; deepens on hover.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Shared easing across house and both subworlds (--ease / --so-ease / --sa-ease).

motion.name: sortie-route-travel
motion.purpose: Signature supply-line highlight traveling along the route; removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: salvo-instrument-sweep
motion.purpose: Single restrained amber instrument sweep across the command hero; removed under reduced motion.

extensions.reducedMotion: Every surface ships a complete prefers-reduced-motion block: subworlds hide their signature motion (Sortie route travel, Salvo instrument sweep) and clamp all animation/transition to ~0.001ms with scroll-behavior auto.

components.name: House Primary Button
components.description: The copper-gradient pill CTA used across Nintek marketing surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-house { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:13px 24px; border-radius:9999px; background:linear-gradient(120deg,#a0522d,#c17a2e); color:#fff; font-family:'Space Grotesk',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:0.95rem; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:0 10px 28px -8px rgba(160,82,45,0.45); transition:transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-house span { transition:transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-house:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 16px 34px -10px rgba(160,82,45,0.6); } .ds-btn-house:hover span { transform:translateX(4px); } .ds-btn-house:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #c17a2e; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Sortie Primary Button
components.description: Cobalt pill action inside the Sortie campaign-atlas subworld.
components.css: .ds-btn-sortie { min-height:48px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:13px; padding:11px 18px; border-radius:9999px; background:#2469e8; color:#fff; font-family:'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:0.84rem; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:0 13px 30px -12px rgba(36,105,232,0.75); transition:transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),background-color 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-sortie:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); background:#3679ec; box-shadow:0 17px 34px -12px rgba(36,105,232,0.85); } .ds-btn-sortie:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #80aefc; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Salvo Primary Button
components.description: Square amber action inside the Salvo field-command subworld — hard-edged, no radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-salvo { min-height:48px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:13px; padding:11px 18px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:0; background:#f59e3d; color:#121b24; font-family:'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:0.82rem; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:0 15px 32px -13px rgba(245,158,61,0.7); transition:transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),background-color 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-salvo:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); background:#ffad52; box-shadow:0 18px 36px -13px rgba(245,158,61,0.84); } .ds-btn-salvo:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #ffd188; outline-offset:3px; }

components.description: Ghost steel-bordered action on the Salvo command surface.

components.name: Nintek Home-Link Mark
components.description: Copper N-grid home link required in every subworld nav, followed by a faint separator.

components.description: Uppercase mono status chip on a subworld nav/hero (e.g. Salvo brass-on-steel pre-release state).
components.css: .ds-state-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:7px 11px; border:1px solid rgba(245,158,61,0.55); border-radius:0; color:#ffd188; background:transparent; font-family:'Martian Mono',ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:0.62rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.05em; text-transform:uppercase; }

narrative.overview: Nintek is one warm, crafted studio that opens onto a hallway of rooms. The house world — cream paper, copper hardware, walnut shadow, Space Grotesk wordmark — is calm, product-led, and consistent across the marketing surfaces. Each dedicated app page is a room: it holds its own light, palette, type, and material so the product feels like itself, but it never stops being part of the house. Two things always travel between rooms — the Nintek home-link mark in the nav and the copper signature in the footer. The rooms are verified, product-native subworlds derived from real software and real captures, not free-for-all reskins. Sortie and Salvo are the two newest rooms and stand as route-specific examples of the subworld pattern, never replacements for the house defaults.
keyCharacteristics: One warm house system (cream / copper / walnut, Space Grotesk) shared by all marketing surfaces.
Dedicated app pages adopt a verified product-native subworld — its own color, type, form language, and real media.
The Nintek home-link mark (nav) and copper N signature (footer) are non-negotiable on every subworld.
Real shipped/pre-release captures only; no invented product UI.
Complete prefers-reduced-motion coverage on every surface, including subworlds.

rules.name: The Copper Signature Rule
rules.body: Copper (#c17a2e) is the family mark, not a subworld accent. Inside a subworld it appears only in the shared Nintek home-link and footer signature; the subworld's own actions use the subworld's own accent (Sortie cobalt, Salvo amber), never copper.

rules.name: The Earned-Palette Rule
rules.body: A subworld's colors must come from the real product it advertises (its art, its UI, its captures). Do not invent a palette to decorate a page.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Each surface pairs exactly one display voice with the mono data voice. House = Space Grotesk + system body; a subworld = Archivo + Martian Mono. Do not mix a subworld's display face into the house chrome.

rules.name: The Warm-Shadow Rule
rules.body: House shadows are tinted with walnut (rgba(28,15,7,...)), never neutral black. Subworld glows are tinted with that subworld's accent.

dos: Do keep every marketing surface on the house world (cream #f5f0ea, copper #c17a2e, walnut ink, Space Grotesk).
Do give a dedicated app page its own verified subworld — palette, type (Archivo + Martian Mono), form language, and real media derived from the actual product.
Do ship the Nintek home-link mark in the subworld nav and the copper N signature in the subworld footer, every time.
Do use warm walnut-tinted shadows in the house and accent-tinted glows in subworlds.

Do ship a complete prefers-reduced-motion block on every surface — subworlds disable their signature motion (Sortie route travel, Salvo instrument sweep) and clamp all animation/transition to ~0.001ms.
Do state pre-release status honestly and show only real shipped/pre-release captures.
donts: Don't use copper as a subworld action color — copper is the family signature only (subworld actions use the subworld accent: Sortie cobalt, Salvo amber).
Don't invent a subworld palette or product UI to decorate a page; earn it from the real product.
Don't carry one subworld's form language into another — Sortie stays rounded/pill/organic, Salvo stays square/steel/no-radius.
Don't drop the Nintek nav home-link or footer signature from any app page, no matter how immersive the subworld.
Don't mix a subworld's display face (Archivo) into the house chrome, or the house wordmark face into a subworld hero.
Don't animate without a reduced-motion fallback, or claim features the product doesn't ship (no multiplayer, economy, or backend sync).
